title: Reconcile main and recover damaged operating records

costar.context: The owner needs a known committed baseline and verified branch and PR integration.
costar.objective: Verify remote and local main, account for every PR and surviving branch, recover exact historical records and commit the repair.
costar.response: A clean pushed main, audit evidence and a passing operating-tree gate.

concerns: main changed concurrently from b335bce to afb98b2 during the audit; it must be rechecked before committing and pushing.
The new root 6693b60 breaks ancestry from older PR merges. Content presence is not proof that every old behavior was preserved.
A historical event id occurs more than once; recovery must match the intact prefix, not only the event id.
CI green does not prove the unrun engine/live/recovery gates or authorize a release.
context: The owner authorizes reconciliation onto main. No new PR is needed or permitted.
current_state: Local and remote main are afb98b27389c918d789b7f2e1da06690b5451888 with a clean tree. Its Check run passed. The only other remote branch tip b09dbc3 is an ancestor of main. Older PR content was carried into a new-root snapshot, which damaged two operating records.
target_design: A known committed and pushed source baseline, exact restoration of damaged historical records, and CI enforcing operating-tree validity.
changes: Restore only the truncated tools.jsonl record from d517c13, matching its full intact prefix.
Restore the missing concerns and boundaries arrays of the historical readiness plan from PR #1 merge 6ef46d1; these remain historical context, not new product restrictions.
Run the operating-tree checker in Check and stop excluding .ai-only changes from CI.
Record branch/PR evidence, commit directly to main and verify the pushed head and checks.
boundaries: Do not merge obsolete historical branches over current code or restore deliberately removed transcript records.
Do not change runtime behavior, licences, historical result claims or release gate statuses.
No release tag, force push, branch deletion or PR creation.

verification.name: historical-recovery
verification.proves: Recovered fields and the one event exactly match their historical sources.
verification.result: Passed: one event from d517c13 selected by its full intact prefix; two arrays deep-equal to 6ef46d1. Temporary recovery helper is local under ignored target/.

verification.name: operating-tree
verification.proves: All registered operating records satisfy their schemas and references.
verification.result: Passed: 6 modules, 50 documents, 406 lines; events 165, messages 62, tools 135, journal 44.

verification.name: diff
verification.proves: The repair introduces no whitespace errors.
